source: KSQAAC Spardha Yashassu NMMS Study Material 2022, MAT Chapter 26 (questions: PDF page 77, solutions: PDF pages 159–160). The key's numbering drifts: it has an extra entry 5 for a question that is not printed, so key 6 is Q5 … key 15 is Q14.

questions.prompt: Put the signs in place of each * in order, so that the statement is true. Which set of signs is right?
questions.rule: Try each set of signs in turn. Work out each side of =, < or > on its own: × and ÷ first, then + and −. Then compare the two sides.

questions.prompt: Which two signs or two numbers must be swapped to make the statement true?
questions.rule: Swap the two signs or numbers, then work out each side: × and ÷ first, then + and −. Then compare the two sides.

questions.prompt: Which two signs or two numbers must be swapped to make the statement true?
questions.rule: Swap the two signs or numbers, then work out each side: × and ÷ first, then + and −. Then compare the two sides.
questions.note: Two options work. The key's C (swap × and ÷) gives 32 ÷ 4 × 6 + 12 = 60, but D (swap 4 and 6) gives 32 × 6 ÷ 4 + 12 = 48 + 12 = 60 too.
